title.narrative: Employment-intensive growth promoted and LMIS strengthened for gender-inclusive job creation

description.narrative: The CPO focusses on supporting policymakers towards formulation of coherent and coordinated policy framework, in an effort to mainstream employment in economic policy making. This is imperative to provide productive and decent employment, especially for the youth. Towards this, the ILO pursues a “whole-of government” approach, involving various ministries, along with representatives of workers, employers, and other relevant stakeholders. The country office has been actively involved in providing technical support to Ministry of Labour and Employment in policy initiatives to support employment for youth and women, and to Ministry of Rural Development in mainstreaming principles of inclusive green economy and green jobs in rural development schemes. The office focusses on employment impact analysis, evidence-based research, capacity needs assessments and capacity development of constituents on employment intensive investment strategies and green jobs in local level planning. Efforts are made to improve constituents’ understanding for informed participation in policymaking. The CPO’s statistical aspect provides the enabling environment, and it adopts three approaches. First is the capacity building to promote the International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS) standards. This is done through targeted engagement with key statistics producers and users and through international courses in collaborations with ITCILO-Turin, STATISTICS and United Nations Statistics Institute of Asia and Pacific (SIAP). Support to the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) continues especially in the development of questionnaires and methodologies aligned to the ICLS standards and analysis. Secondly, the CPO continues to support SDG reporting focusing on the gaps identified in the SDGs under the custodianship or co-custodianship of ILO. Thirdly, the CPO supports the development of Labour Market Information System (LMIS).
